models_evaluated: Commercial AI chest radiograph lung cancer detection devices from seven manufacturers (unnamed in abstract)

links.outcome: Head-to-head diagnostic accuracy of competing commercial AI devices on same local dataset, incl. versus radiologist reporting
links.effect: AUC varied 0.80-0.94 (P<.05 for 9 of 15 pairwise comparisons); sensitivity 20.8%-77.8%, specificity 58.9%-98.4%; additional false positives vs radiologist reporting ranged 10 to 2039.
links.quote: There was clinically and statistically significant variability in the diagnostic accuracy of commercial AI devices for lung cancer detection at chest radiography.

links.outcome: Device performance on a local consecutive primary care population against multidisciplinary team reference standard
links.effect: Sensitivity 20.8%-77.8%, specificity 58.9%-98.4%, PPV 1.5%-28.4% across devices at a single UK center.
links.quote: The sensitivity (20.8%-77.8%), specificity (58.9%-98.4%), and positive predictive value (1.5%-28.4%) varied (P < .001 and P < .05 for 39 of 44 pairwise comparisons).

unlisted_practices: Independent head-to-head comparison of multiple commercial AI devices at representative disease prevalence

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative evaluation/benchmark of multiple commercial AI devices on a representative clinical dataset for lung cancer detection on chest radiographs.
